༄༅/ /ni gu lugs kyi bde mchog lha lnga'i mngon rtogs bzhugs so/ /oṃ swasti/rgyal ba mchog rnams kun gyi dngos/ /lhan skyes dga' chen he ru

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ni gu lugs kyi bde mchog lha lnga'i mngon rtogs bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ rgyal ba mchog rnams kun gyi dngos/ /lhan skyes dga' chen he ru ka/ /ye shes lnga ldan dkyil 'khor la/ /btud nas de yi sgrub thabs bshad/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang / /mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig gis/ /rigs lnga'i lha tshogs byon par gyur/ /bdag gi sdig sgrib ma lus pa sbyang du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ thugs ka nas lha mo bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs pa spros/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing khrus byas pas/ dbang bzhi thob/ sdig sgrib thams cad dag lus shel gong g.ya' dag pa ltar gyur/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar nang mchod byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes sbyangs/ oṃ a mri ta bā tsa rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ rang gi sems nyid gzung 'dzin gnyis bral gyi ye shes spros pa mtha' dag gis dben pa'o/ /zhes mnyam par bzhag rang skad cig gis 'khor lo sdom pa'i skur gyur pa'i thugs kar hūm̐/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las raṃ 'og phyogs su mched/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ hūm̐ spros pa las sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyis sa gzhi dang de las 'phros pa'i rwa gur du gyur/ hūm̐ las hūm̐ dpag tu med pa phyogs bcur spros/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa nas dgu pa'i bar du gyur pas bar mtshams med par bltams pa/ nyi ma las 'bar ba'i mes rab tu zhu ste rwa gur gyi phyi rol dum bu gcig tu 'dres shing / phyi nang kun tu me lces gang bar gyur/ snying kha'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ni/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang / /khro bo chos skyong bcas pa la/ /bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi/

/lan gsum/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par lan gsum/ skyabs yul de rnams bdag gi mdun du byon te/ 'od zer rang gi lus la phog pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs te/ me long dang gzugs brnyan ltar rang dang skyabs yul dbyer med du gyur/ slar yang snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dpal he ru ka lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur/ oṃ na maḥte hūm̐/ na mo me hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐/ zhes phyag 'tshal/ arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gnyis kyis nang mchod dang gsang mchod phul/ mchod bya/ mchod byed/ mchod pa rnams gnyis su med cing dmigs su med pa'o/ /zhes de kho na nyid kyis mchod pa bya/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum bya/ tshogs zhing 'od gsal gyi ngang du thim/ oṃ swa bhā wa buddha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ gzung ba rang bzhin med pa'i bdag nyid do/ /oṃ shūn+ya ta dzñā na swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ 'dzin pa yang rang bzhin mi dmigs te/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid do/ /zhes mnyam par gzhag stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis phyi rol dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ suṃ las ri rgyal lhun po shar shel/ byang gser/ nub padma rā ga lho bai ḍūrya las grub pa/ bang rim bzhi dang ldan zhing lcog brgyad kyis brgyan pa gru bzhi pa ste/ 'byung bzhi ri rab rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa'o/ /de'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad ma'i lte bar/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje/ shar dkar byang ljang nub dmar lho ser/ lte ba mthing nag gru bzhi pa/

de'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba dang ge sar du bcas pa dang / padma'i lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'o/ /de'i steng du rang sems zla ba dmar skya la gnas pa'i hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus te thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/ brten pa lha'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rang nyid dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing ga ind+ra ni la ltar 'bar ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum g.yo ba/ khro zhing sgeg la chags pa'i nyams can mche ba'i myu gu gtsigs pa/ bzhin shin tu 'gyur ba'i khro gnyer bsdus shing 'jigs su rung ba bung ba ltar gnag pa'i dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa/ rtse mo rus pa'i 'khor lo la gnas pa'i nor bu dang / ral pa'i ngos la sna tshogs rdo rje dang / g.yon ngos su zla ba phyed pas brgyan pa/ mi rus kyi rna cha dang mgul rgyan dang gdub bu'i tshogs dang ske rags dang mchod phyir sogs kyis brgyan pa/ thal ba chen po nye bar byugs shing / mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs dang bcas pa/ mi'i rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i khrag 'dzag mgo bo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po dang g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo mnan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing / mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /de la 'khyud pa'i yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo/ bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis phyogs thams cad gnon zhing /

g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang do shal can/ zhabs g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs pas yab la 'khyud pa/ yab yum gnyis ka yang lang tsho gsar du bdo ba/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma mthing ga byang du lā ma ljang gu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mchan khung du rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga dang bcas shing / mi ro'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rdo rje phag mo dang mtshungs shing phag mo'i rigs las byung ba'o/ /mtshams bzhir bdud rtsi'i lngas gang ba'i bum pa thod pas kha rgyan pa dang bcas pa rnams 'khod par gyur/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor phaiṃ/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shuddha sarba dharma yo ga shuddho3haṃ/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ yang snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' khro bo'i dbang po rnams btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas yum lnga bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs pa spros/ oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing / bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo dang / mkha' 'gro ma la mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje phag mo la rnam snang / lā ma la don yod grub pa/ dum skyes ma la 'od dpag med/

gzugs can ma la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan pa/ cung zad byas pa la spro na lha dbang bskur ba'i skabs 'dir/ byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / a bhi ṣe ka'i sngags kyis dbang bskur ba'i lugs kyang yod pa ltar spro na bya'o/ /de nas bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs kyang rung mod kyi/ lag len la de lta bu gtso bor mi mdzad do/ /des nas bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba nang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang myos byed kyis gang ba/ de'i steng du dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga skad cig gis bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ hrī ha ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan bdun sogs ci rigs bzla/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs thod pa'i steng gi he ru ka lha lnga'i sku la thim/ sbyor mtshams dang / gsang ba'i sgo nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ gzhir gnas kyi dam rdzas dang 'dres te ye shes kyi bdud rtsi thod pa gang bar gyur pa la/ lha lnga po rnams kyang bdud rtsir zhu ste thim/ so so'i snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags te bdud rtsi myangs pas/ lha thams cad bde bas mnyes par bsam/ bar 'dir rdzogs rim rtsa 'khor lo bzhi pa'i gtum mo dang / rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya ste yig rnying las shes par bya'o/ /de bzhin du yig rnying las 'byung ba ltar bzlas pa'i dmigs pa yang gsal btab la/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki ni dzwa la sambha raṃ swā hā/ yab kyi snying po'o/ /oṃ hrī ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nye snying ngo / /oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ yum gyi snying po'o/ /oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ nye snying ngo / /oṃ ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ lā me hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro he hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ru pi nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

'khor rnams kyi sngags so/ /zhes ci nus su bzla/ gtor chog dang 'brel ba yin na skabs 'dir gtor ma gtong ba yin na'ang sgrub thabs tsam sgom pa la/ skabs 'dir gtor ma nges par dgos pa ma yin pas/ dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu byas te thun mtshams la 'jug go /de yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ de rnams 'od du zhu/ bdag nyid kyis sgom pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor 'od du zhu/ lha mo bzhi la thim/ lha mo bzhi rang la thim/ yum yang yab kyi thugs kar thim/ dpal he ru ka yang 'od gsal gyi dbyings su thim par gyur/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag 'od gsal gyi ngang las slar yang he ru ka'i skur gyur/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ/ thugs kar hūm̐/ kun tu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje 'chang chen go 'phang ldan/ /bdag gi dge ba 'dis thob ste/ /'gro kun gyis kyang thob par shog /rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir spyod gang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas nas gang spyod pa/ /byang chub rdo rje sngags pa yi/ /spyod pa de nyid bdag spyod shog /ces dge ba bsngo ba'o/ /gtor ma gtong bar 'dod na/ legs par bshams te/ sumbhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ yaṃ las rlung dang / raṃ las me'i steng du/ kaṃ las me mgo'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i a las ka pā la/ de'i nang du padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir/ na ko ku da ha las mi/ ba glang / khyi/ rta/ glang chen te sha lnga/ dbus dang mtshams bzhir mu bi ra shu ma las/ chu sman/ rngul/ khu ba/ klad pa ste bdud rtsi lnga/ sha lnga'i thad kyi steng rnams su/ hūm̐ oṃ traṃ hrīḥ.a ye shes lnga'i ngo bo/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la zla ba la oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las byung ba/ bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyis kha ṭwāṃ ga dkar po mgo bo thur du lta ba/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas bcu yi ge bco lnga dang bcas pa zhu/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'bru gsum gyi 'od kyis sbyang rtogs sbar gsum du byas/ kha ṭwāṃ ga'i rtse mor hūm̐/ de'i 'od kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug nas kha ṭwāṃ ga la thim/ zla ba yi ge gsum kha ṭwāṃ ga dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung / kha ṭwāṃ gas dkrugs pas thams cad zhu ste/ dam rdzas dang gnyis su med par gyur pas gtor ma ye shes bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ ha ho hrīḥ lan mang du brjod/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /rang gi mdun du 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang / rigs drug gi sems can thams cad/ he ru ka yab yum gyi rnam par gyur pas phyogs thams cad nas bskor ba grub par gyur/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas phaiṃ/ oṃ badzra a ralli ho dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badzra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya satwaṃ/ dri shya ho/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad ye shes 'khor lo'i rnam par byon pa rnams dam tshig 'khor lo dang ro gcig tu gyur/ mgron bskyed pa'o/ /lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje bu gus gtor ma gsol bar gyur/ oṃ badzra ḍā ki ni i daṃ ba liṃ gṝhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yi ge bdun pa dang / bai ro tsa na dang / mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i sngags rnams kyi mthar/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes btags pa lan lngas 'bul te ye shes lha la mchod pa'o/ /oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba/ yakṣa/ rakṣa/ bhuta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsa/ ud manta/ a pasma ra/ ḍā ka/ ḍā ki/ n+ya da ya/ i maṃ ba liṃ/ grihṇan tu/ sa ma ya rakṣāntu/ ma ma sarba siddhi me pra yatstshantu/ ya the baṃ/ ya thaiṣṭaṃ/ bhuñdza thā/ pi ba thā/ dzi ghā thā/ ma ti kra ma thā/ ma ma sarba karta ya/ sad su khaṃ/ bi shuddha sa hā si ka bha bantu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum gyis dur khrod na gnas pa dang 'byung po'i tshogs la 'bul/ arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/

'bru gsum gyis nang mchod 'bul/ yab yum gyi rkang pa brgya'i gsang sngags kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das bde mchog 'khor dang bcas/ /khyed la mchod cing bstod pa yis/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyis sdong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba/ /bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pas 'phrin las gzhol lo/ /gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas/ /legs byas 'di la nyes gyur gang / /gang phyir lus can skyabs gyur pa/ /de kun mgon khyod bzod par gsol/ /zhes pa bzod par gsol lo/ /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub gsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ badzra muḥzhes mgron gshegs su gsol/ /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad nad med pa/ /sangs rgyas nyid du 'gro ba yi/ /lam de nyid du 'grub gyur cig /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis 'grol/ /rnal 'byor gtsug lag bstan bcos la/ /da lta nyid du gnas par shog /ces smon lam btab/ legs pa'i yon tan rab rdzogs pa/ /bla ma yi dam bkra shis shog /'phrin las thams cad sgrub mdzad pa/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong bkra shis shog /ces shis pa brjod/ dge ba'i tshogs rnams bsags pa kun/ /bdag gir yongs su bzung med par/ /sems can ma lus kun don du/ /chos dbyings bla na med par bsngo/

/zhes dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dgongs don gang / /blo dman rnams la nyer mkho'i phyir/ /ngag 'don cung zad bsdebs pa yi/ /dge bas 'gro kun grol gyur cig /ces pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //dge'o// //maṅgalaṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 8 tā ra nā tha/ ni gu lugs kyi bde mchog lha lnga'i mngon rtogs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 7
